example-nullable-warning.title: CS8602: Dereference of a possibly null reference
example-nullable-warning.short: A nullable reference is used without proving it is non-null
example-nullable-warning.summary: This demonstrates a warning produced by nullable flow analysis.
example-nullable-warning.why: The compiler tracks a path where the value can still be null.
example-nullable-warning.tips: Prefer a guard or better type design over suppressing the warning blindly.
